interest: Illuminates corporate maneuvering breaking foreign oil solidarity under Manchukuo's monopoly and Soviet intelligence probing Dairen's aerial vulnerability.
overview: This file contains consular despatches from the American Consulate in Dairen and Department of State Far Eastern Affairs memoranda from 1935 to 1938 concerning the enforcement of the Manchukuo Petroleum Monopoly and the operations of the Manshu Sekiyu refinery at Kanseishi in the Kwantung Leased Territory. The documents trace raw crude imports from California, Bahrain, and Europe, refinery production statistics, supply shortages, and exploratory drilling at Chalainor. Additionally, the collection covers negotiations over compensation for dispossessed foreign oil companies, The Texas Company breaking corporate solidarity to make independent supply arrangements, Soviet inquiries into the aerial vulnerability of Dairen oil storage installations, and an extraneous misfiled report on Uruguayan agriculture.
